# utilities.consolidation.get_country_name

### utilities.consolidation.get_country_name(code: [str](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str)) → [str](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str) | [None](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/constants.html#None)

Get country name from ISO alpha-2 code.

* **Parameters:**
  **code** – ISO alpha-2 country code
* **Returns:**
